title: Four-beat partner rotation
prompt: Three people greet each other in turn: person 1 shakes hands with person 2 and releases; person 2 shakes hands with person 3 and releases; finally person 1 shakes hands with person 3. Then person 1 returns to greet person 2 with another handshake.

beats.prompt: Person 1 and person 2 shake hands, then release.
Person 2 and person 3 shake hands, then release.
Person 1 and person 3 shake hands, then release.
Person 1 returns to person 2 and they shake hands, then release.
